maintenance_led.reason: Aftermarket aircraft parts supply and airframe/component MRO for airlines and governments keep existing fleets flying; new-build work is minor.

publicly_funded.reason: Largest parts supply and MRO revenue comes from commercial airlines; government solutions (defense, mobility shelters) is the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic parts, MRO and program wins; acquisitions like Trax, Airinmar and Aerostrat are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Certified aircraft MRO, qualified parts and embedded software like Trax eMRO carry safety, regulatory and switching costs for airlines.
